# Qnity to Acquire Meridian’s Electronics Business, Expands Advanced Packaging and Thermal Management Capabilities


November 23, 2026 6:30am EST[Download as PDF](https://ir.qnityelectronics.com/_assets/_0ca33d993cc59b0d6fdea1edbf4fcb4f/qnityelectronics/news/2026-11-23_Qnity_to_Acquire_Meridian_s_Electronics_Business_86.pdf)


*Adds new capabilities to better serve optical and photonics applications*


*Expected to be immediately accretive to Adjusted Gross Margin, Adjusted EBITDA Margin, and Adjusted EPS*


WILMINGTON, Del.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Qnity Electronics, Inc. (“Qnity”) (NYSE: Q), a premier technology solutions provider across the semiconductor value chain, today announced it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire the electronics business of Meridian Adhesives Group (“Meridian”), a global adhesives manufacturer. The business will be part of Qnity’s Interconnect Solutions segment, adding differentiated technology capabilities to the Company’s fastest-growing platforms.


“Our disciplined M&A strategy is focused on high-value technologies critical to enabling next-generation semiconductor applications. As AI increases the complexity of packaging, connecting, and cooling systems, the industry is shifting towards new architectures and designs, including the adoption of optical connectivity solutions,” said Jon Kemp, Qnity’s Chief Executive Officer. “This acquisition adds leading capabilities in the growing market for optical and photonics solutions and expands our product offerings for thermal management and signal integrity. We expect the complementary capabilities will create immediate growth opportunities and look forward to welcoming Meridian’s talented electronics team to Qnity.”


Meridian’s electronics business is a leading provider of epoxy-based optical-grade, electrically conductive, and thermally conductive adhesives, which enable high-speed data transmission, efficient thermal management, and enhanced performance and reliability.


“We are incredibly proud of the leadership position our team has built in electronics adhesives supported by our deep customer relationships, differentiated competitive position, and strong culture of innovation,” said Brian Brace, Commercial President of Meridian electronics. “Joining Qnity represents an exciting next chapter of growth for our business as we combine our capabilities and expertise to meet our customers’ evolving needs and deliver even greater value.”


**Transaction highlights**


The acquisition strengthens two core growth platforms in Qnity’s Interconnect Solutions segment – thermal management and advanced packaging – and broadens the company’s system-level solutions as the industry shifts toward shrink and stack.


- Brings new capabilities in high-performance specialty electronics adhesives, including optical-grade materials, to better serve growing optical and photonics applications.
- Strengthens position in high-growth and high-value end-markets including AI data center, semiconductor equipment, and aerospace and defense, where the majority of Meridian’s electronics business revenues are generated.
- Revenues from Meridian’s electronics business are expected to be approximately $100 million for calendar year 2026, with double digit growth expected to continue in calendar year 2027.
- Adds a new serviceable addressable market of approximately $1.2 billion growing double digits annually.
- Expected to be immediately accretive to Qnity’s Adjusted Gross Margin, Adjusted Operating EBITDA Margin, and Adjusted EPS.
- Aligns to business model of delivering repeatable revenue, driven by the design-in nature of its products, deep relationships with blue-chip customers, and ~97% customer retention over the past five years measured by revenue.


**Transaction details**


Under the terms of the agreement, Qnity will pay Meridian Adhesives Group the $840 million purchase price in cash on hand and incremental borrowings under the Company’s existing revolving credit facility. The transaction is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027, subject to customary closing conditions and the expiration of the applicable waiting period (and any extension thereof) under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976, as amended.


**Advisors**


Piper Sandler served as financial advisor and Paul, Weiss, Rifkind, Wharton & Garrison LLP served as legal counsel to Qnity. J.P. Morgan and Citi served as financial advisors and Weil, Gotshal & Manges LLP and Benesch, Friedlander, Coplan & Aronoff LLP served as legal counsel to Meridian Adhesives Group.

Qnity is a premier technology provider across the semiconductor value chain, empowering AI, high-performance computing, and advanced connectivity. From groundbreaking solutions for semiconductor chip manufacturing, to enabling high-speed transmission within complex electronic systems, our high-performance materials and integration expertise make tomorrow’s technologies possible. **About Meridian Adhesives Group**


Meridian Adhesives Group is a leading manufacturer of high-performance adhesives, providing cutting-edge solutions across electronics, infrastructure, packaging, and product assembly markets. With a strong portfolio of innovative brands, Meridian is dedicated to delivering superior adhesive technologies to meet the evolving needs of global customers.
